description:
Cast Stoneforge Acolyte by paying {W/P}.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Whenever Stoneforge Acolyte enters the battlefield, it and Ondu Cleric triggers, causing you to gain at least two life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Stoneforge Acolyte and the Soldier token, adding {1}{W}.
Whenever Stoneforge Acolyte dies, Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Stoneforge Acolyte from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
